_: Four scenarios of 27 November 2026 over the 70-76 Riley Street study, read at 0 degrees (the sun counted on a wall until it is parallel to it): 1, step 5 of 25 November, every block at 7 storeys; 2, the sketch of 27 November with every tower round us at 12 storeys; 3, the same at 14 storeys; 4, as 3 with Crown St north built as the LEP allows with the 30 % in-fill affordable housing bonus. 88-108 and 72-80 William St are taken away in every scenario. The scenarios before these are in the .future-sketch.json file.

site.label: our site, sketch of 25 Nov

tower._: The sketch of 25 November 2026: a three-storey podium over the lot (a taller ground floor and two residential levels) and the tower to 14 storeys, 6 m off our northern boundary (66-68 Riley St), 3 m off Riley Street and Crown Lane, 3 m off Stanley Lane. No apartment layout is given for this footprint, so its apartments are read in 8 m bays along its walls.

site._units: Not known: the sketch has no plans, so nothing is said of its apartments; its sun is read off its facade (future_facade_sun.py).

scenarios.title: Step 5: every block at 7 storeys, 23.4 m
scenarios.horizon: The three blocks round us and ours each built to 7 storeys, the 23.4 m height of building: a four-storey podium over the lot and three storeys above it, set back.
scenarios.lead: Every block round us is built to 7 storeys, the 23.4 m height of building: across Riley Street, 67-107 Riley St as one site; north of us, 54-68 Riley St with 1 Crown Lane, 66-68 Riley St with them; across Crown Lane, the whole Crown Street block, 89 to 129 Crown St with 4 and 10 Crown Lane. Each is a four-storey podium over its lot and three storeys above it, held 3 m off its two long street frontages. The William Street towers are taken away, as in every scenario; 109 Riley St, the former hotel, is a heritage item (I436) and stays. Ours is built the same way: a four-storey podium over our lot and three storeys above it, built to our northern boundary so it joins the block north of us, and 3 m off Riley Street, Crown Lane and Stanley Lane, 7 storeys in all.
